concepts.def: X- ion with full outer shell

walkthroughs.body_html:
2Na + 2H2O -> 2NaOH + H2.

Test gas with a lit splint - squeaky pop.

Solution turns indicator purple (alkaline).

2Na + Cl2 -> 2NaCl.

Sodium loses e- (oxidised), chlorine gains e- (reduced).

Product is an ionic salt.

Cl2 + 2KBr -> 2KCl + Br2.

Chlorine is more reactive than bromine.

No reaction if added halogen is less reactive (e.g. I2 + KCl).
